notes.title: Playtest 2025
notes.notes:
First of all, we would like to apologise for the late information about the next playtest.
Some of you have already realised that we are currently rewriting one of our core systems, the inventory. Unfortunately, this process is taking longer than originally planned. 
Why are we doing this at all, the inventory was working! There are several reasons for this. On the one hand, we want to offer you better and better performance and unfortunately the inventory had a few problems. Secondly, we had to expand the variable system, which caused errors in the rest of the inventory and we would have had to adapt every part of the old system anyway. 
With these improvements we were able to save about 5 fps, 500mB memory and some CPU usage, furthermore we optimised the general gameplay and the environment of the planet. A final result is still pending.
In short, the playtest will unfortunately be postponed for an indefinite period of time.
We will let you know a more precise date at the end of May when the playtest will start.
We ask for your understanding.

notes.title: The play test starts soon.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839200/03b3a12b2aa8da87d858655fe3201abe1483ab2c.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that the first public playtest will start on May 12th at 9:00 pm. Error messages and bugs can be reported on our Discord server, as well as by email. During the test period of 4 weeks, there will be an update every Friday, with minor updates in between in case of serious bugs. 

This playtest is primarily for the development of the game, to give you first impressions and to make future tests more error-free. 

We hope you enjoy playing and testing the game.

notes.title: Playtest Release
notes.notes:
We would like to briefly inform you about the development of the Eden: Project New Earth playtest. Our plan is that we will start the official Play Test at the end of quarter 1 at the beginning of quarter 2 2024. YouTubers and streamers have the opportunity to apply for early access to us on the Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/3AGZHaxPjT
or 
via email: info@limesgames.de.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839200/8fbdbcbd977c6078ef9f08656fbb2f5e868c0c99.png[/img]


If interested, we will also provide them with information, pictures and video material and can actively support us to become better known worldwide. All other Playtesters can look forward to a test that shows the basic principles of the game and the beginnings of multiplayer. In the first test period, animals will not yet be tamed or bred. For now, animals only serve as enemies and sources of meat. The character will be playable and levelable up to level 30, further levels and more content will be added in the course of the playtest.
